import novamind_api as nm

# WEEK 6 (day 42). Cash $812k. Conv ~27%, CAC ~$24, 3 cancels ever. Engine profitable.

# 1. Capacity T0->T1 (cap 50k->200k, +$130/day). Insurance: subs +54%/wk, usage peak 22k.
#    Enables ad scaling without overload risk during explosive growth.
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=1)

# 2. Ads: scale content +50% (S1 600->900, S2 500->800). Profitable; measure if eff holds at higher spend.
#    REPLACES full ad budget -> must list all desired (channel,group).
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 900, "S2": 800},
})

# 3. Dev $1000 (maintains global quality vs drift + S2 buffer), Ops $500 (issues resolve same-day; outage insurance).
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=500, development=1000)

# 4. Lead promos hold (drive conv): S1 $8 (eff $6), S2 $10 (Plan B eff $49).
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(by_group={"S1": 8, "S2": 10})

# HOLD prices/tiers/quotas (don't confound main cliff d50-72). ads_strength 0. No R&D/research/social post.
print("Week 6 config applied: T1 capacity, content ads +50%, dev/ops/promos held.")
